notes: Resolved parent/sub-theme overlaps: removed temple (body parts), neck (joints), bangs and fringe (hair), neuron, synapse and spinal cord (brain parts), nose (smell words), insomnia (symptoms), gout (historic diseases). Fu Manchu (hair) removed: named after a novel character still under copyright in places, and a dated stereotype. Down syndrome gets uk "Down's syndrome". Kept E coli, C diff and St Vitus'/St Anthony's/St John's without periods since the checker rejects '.'; the standard forms are E. coli, C. diff, St. John's wort. Kept COVID (usual name) rather than COVID-19. Skipped 20/20 vision (slash not allowed). Separate: hair, skin words (shampoo, tattoo, acne are not body parts); blood words and teeth (transfusion, braces, filling are not 'inside the body'); body systems (adjectives like nervous, digestive); all senses sub-themes (glance, noise, soft, retina, hammer, garlic do not read as senses); allergies, injuries, symptoms (peanut, bruise, cough are not illnesses). Not separate: face, hands and feet, arms and legs, torso, joints, paired body parts, hairstyles, bones, organs, muscles, brain parts, hormones, common/childhood/historic/tropical/cold weather illnesses, infections, medicines.
